dedupe_keys.name: code for probabilistic forecasting of potential available power under control induced censoring for a one turbine wind to hydrogen off grid microgrid

description: Kefan Chen publishes versioned code for forecasting the potential available power of a wind turbine in an off-grid wind-to-hydrogen microgrid. Zenodo lists one public archive under BSD 3-Clause for software; its metadata says tracked derived data have a separate CC BY 4.0 licence. The release includes frozen experiment configurations, tests, protocols and compact reference outputs. This statistical model can supply wind-power uncertainty to dispatch or hydrogen-production simulations when control actions censor observed generation. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this forecasting implementation; two separately cited Zenodo datasets are stated as upstream inputs and are not assumed to be included here. Coverage is the one-turbine study configuration, not all wind fleets or climate regions. A limitation is that the public page does not state a forecast horizon or proven transfer performance. The archive was not downloaded, its tests were not run, and prediction calibration was not checked.
